model.name: NYSE top 100 long-term scorecard
model.summary: Each NYSE top 100 company is scored 0-100 on six pillars: quality and profitability (24), valuation against its sector (18), growth (17), 12-1 month momentum (16), financial strength (13) and risk and drawdown (12). Pillars without data are dropped and the rest re-weighted; low coverage caps the band.
